column1: # Every file still mirrored from mvm, as <path in mvm> TAB <path here>.
# scripts/check-source-drift.sh compares each against mvm at the pinned commit.
# A file with a rewrite has sources/rewrites/<path here>.patch; the patch is the
# whole of the intended difference, and SOURCES.md says why.
# The pin advanced past mvm's W8 deletion (tinylabscom/mvm 62e1116866, release
# v0.18.3): mvm no longer carries its in-tree image recipes, so the copies
# here — images/, kernel/, qemu-wasm/, scripts/ — are the canonical sources
# and are not mirrored rows any more. Their rows retired with the pin
